  • Humanitarian / Medical aid: Times of Israel reports a six-year-old Gaza burn victim is caught in an Israeli dispute over medical aid.
  • Operational impact: The report indicates the child's access to medical assistance is affected by the dispute.

0.5.he:
עדכון מצב

  • הומניטרי / סיוע רפואי: Times of Israel מדווח שקטין בן 6 מעזה שנפגע בשריפה נמצא במרכז מחלוקת ישראלית על סיוע רפואי.
  • השפעה מבצעית: הדיווח מציין כי גישת הילד לטיפול רפואי מושפעת מהמחלוקת.
  • מגמת איום: ראיות לא מספקות להערכת המגמה.

2.en:
Situation update — last 2 hours

  • Strikes / active clashes:
    • IRGC Navy reported an LNG carrier hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz (TASS).
    • Ansarullah (Houthi) forces advanced and captured Jabal al Misas and Al Fassayah along the southern coast road (CIG_telegram).
    • IRGC claims it struck a U.S. early‑warning radar in Bahrain in response to an attack on a communications tower in southern Iran (AbuAliExpress).
  • Northern Lebanon / Beirut:
    • Reports of Israeli drones flying at low altitude over Beirut (warmonitors).
  • Gaza — humanitarian & security:
    • IDF/COGAT state winter supplies continue to enter Gaza; medical and sanitation infrastructure being strengthened (idfofficial).
    • Report of a six‑year‑old Gaza burn victim entangled in an Israeli dispute over medical aid (Times of Israel).
    • Al Jazeera: rain threatens Gaza’s power and healthcare access.
    • Report alleging IDF drones placing explosives on buildings in Zaytoun, east Gaza (AbuAliExpress).
  • Maritime / partnerships:
    • IDF announced a concluded visit by the U.S. Fifth Fleet commander, noting stronger Israel–U.S. maritime cooperation (@IDF).
    • Oil benchmark Brent rising to ~$96 amid renewed tensions (AbuAliExpress).
  • International oversight / political:
    • IAEA increasingly concerned about an Iranian enrichment plant (Reuters).
    • Political: Trump said he would view not toppling the Iranian regime by end of his term as a defeat (Times of Israel).
  • Threat trend: Escalating regional maritime and cross‑border confrontation in the last two hours; elevated risk to shipping and strikes.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF/COGAT report continued delivery of winter supplies and reinforcement of medical/sanitation services in Gaza; U.S.–Israeli maritime ties publicly reinforced.
2.he:
עדכון מצב — השעתיים האחרונות

  • התקפות / עימותים פעילים:
    • חיל הים של משמרות המהפכה דיווח כי מכלית גז טבעי נושאת פגזה בנמל הורמוז (TASS).
    • אנצאראללה (חות'ים) התקדם ולכד את ג'בל אל מיסאס ואל פאסאיה לאורך כביש החוף הדרומי (CIG_telegram).
    • טענה של משמרות המהפכה כי הם תקפו רדאר התרעה מוקדמת אמריקאי בבחריין בתגובה לפגיעה במגדל תקשורת בדרום איראן (AbuAliExpress).
  • צפון / ביירות:
    • דיווחים על רחפנים ישראליים טסים בגובה נמוך מעל ביירות (warmonitors).
  • עזה — הומניטארי וביטחוני:
    • צה"ל ו-COGAT מדווחים על המשך כניסת אספקת חורף וחיזוק שירותים רפואיים ותברואה (idfofficial).
    • דיווח על ילדה בת שש מפגיעה מכוּרת שנקלעת לסכסוך עם ישראל על מתן טיפול רפואי (Times of Israel).
    • אל ג'זירה: גשם מסכן את אספקת החשמל והשירותים הרפואיים בעזה.
    • דיווח הטוען שרחפנים של צה"ל מניחים חומרי נפץ על מבנים בשכונת זיתון מזרחית (AbuAliExpress).
  • ימי / שותפויות:
    • צה"ל דיווח על סיום ביקור מפקד הצי החמישי של ארה"ב וחיזוק שיתוף הפעולה הימי בין המדינות (@IDF).
    • מחיר הברנט מטפס לכ־96$ על רקע המתיחות (AbuAliExpress).
  • פיקוח בינלאומי / פוליטיקה:
    • סוכנות הבינלאומית לאנרגיה אטומית מביעה דאגה גוברת לגבי אתר העשרת אורניום באיראן (Reuters).
    • הצהרה פוליטית: טראמפ אמר שיחשיב ככישלון אם המשטר האיראני לא יוסר עד תום כהונתו (Times of Israel).
  • מגמת איום: עלייה במתחים הימיים והחלפות תקיפות חוצות גבולות בשעתיים האחרונות; סיכון מוגבר לספנות ולפעילות צבאית.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: דווח על המשך אספקת ציוד חורף וחיזוק שירותים רפואיים ותברואה בעזה; חיזוק פומבי של שיתוף הפעולה הימי ישראל–ארה"ב.

6.en:
Situation Report — last 6 hours

  • Attacks reported: IRGC claims it targeted and destroyed a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain with suicide drones. A Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) carrier reportedly struck a mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz (IRGC Navy statement / Reuters / TASS).
  • Gaza
    • IDF/COGAT say winter supplies and medical/sanitation reinforcement continue into Gaza.
    • Reports of Israeli strikes near Khan Younis; civilian casualties include a six-year-old burn victim caught in a dispute over medical aid.
    • Al Jazeera warns rain risks loss of power and healthcare access in Gaza.
    • Local reports allege Israeli drones placing explosives on buildings in eastern Gaza.
  • Lebanon / Northern sector
    • Open-source reports of Israeli drones flying at low altitude over Beirut.
  • Iran / Nuclear
    • IAEA expresses increasing concern about an Iranian enrichment plant and reports no information or access from Iran on its nuclear facilities and materials.
  • Gulf & regional fighting
    • IRGC-linked claims of strikes on U.S. assets in Bahrain stated as retaliation for strikes on Sirik, Iran.
    • Yemeni developments: Houthi (Ansarullah) reports capture of Jabal al Misas and Al Fassayah; other sources report mixed frontline activity including government counterattacks.
  • Maritime / Security cooperation
    • U.S. Fifth Fleet commander concluded a visit to Israel; IDF highlights strengthened maritime partnership with the U.S.
    • Brent crude reported rising to ~$96 per barrel amid renewed Iran tensions.
  • Political
    • Former U.S. President Trump issued escalatory rhetoric toward Iran, saying he would consider non-toppling of the regime a defeat.
  • Threat trend: Escalatory indicators — multiple kinetic incidents across Gulf, Gaza, Lebanon and Yemen within the period.
  • 🟢 Good News: Humanitarian/winter supplies entry into Gaza continues. U.S.-Israel maritime cooperation reinforced by Fifth Fleet visit.

24.en:
Situation Report — 13 Nov 2026 (last 24 hrs)

  • Active attacks reported
    • IRGC claims it targeted and destroyed a U.S. early‑warning radar in Bahrain using suicide drones (IRGC claim).
    • Reports that an LNG carrier/tanker struck a mine in the Strait of Hormuz and suffered an explosion (IRGC/TASS/Reuters reporting Iran statement).
    • Israeli strikes in Gaza: a midnight strike on a tent near Khan Younis killed two people; reports of rising casualties from a strike at Nasser Hospital.
  • Maritime / Energy
    • Mine/explosion incident in the Strait of Hormuz affecting an LNG vessel (multiple sources reported Iran/IRGC statements).
    • Brent crude price rose toward $96 amid renewed tensions (market report).
  • Iran nuclear / IAEA
    • IAEA expresses increasing concern about an Iranian enrichment plant and reports it has not received information or access to Iranian nuclear facilities/materials.
  • Military posture / partnerships
    • U.S. Fifth Fleet commander completed a visit to Israel; Israel and U.S. say they are strengthening the maritime partnership.
    • U.S. political rhetoric intensified: high‑level statements about regime change in Iran (reported comments by former U.S. president).
  • Northern sector
    • Reports of Israeli drones flying at low altitude over Beirut.
  • Gaza — humanitarian
    • IDF/COGAT report continued humanitarian and winter preparations: entry of winter supplies, strengthening medical services and sanitation infrastructure.
    • Local reports claim Israeli drones placing explosives on buildings in Zeitoun (unverified).
    • Coverage highlights power and healthcare risks in Gaza with rain/winter approaching.
  • Yemen / regional fighting
    • Ansarullah/Houthi advances reported on southern coast positions; Yemeni government forces say they repelled a large Houthi attack in southeastern Taiz.
  • Threat trend: Escalating — multiple cross‑domain incidents (maritime mine/explosion, claimed strike on U.S. radar, strikes in Gaza, drones over Beirut) indicate increased tensions.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF/COGAT report continued entry of winter supplies and medical/sanitation reinforcement in Gaza; U.S.–Israel maritime coordination formally reaffirmed by Fifth Fleet visit.

48.en:
Situation report — key events (last 48 hrs)

  • Active strikes/incidents —
  • Israeli strikes in Gaza: Overnight strike on a tent near Khan Younis killed two named individuals. Casualty count from the Nasser hospital strike in Khan Younis has risen.
  • Strait of Hormuz — Reports (IRGC / TASS / Reuters) say an LNG tanker/carrier hit a mine and suffered an explosion.
  • IRGC claims an attack on a U.S. radar in Bahrain using suicide drones (Iranian statements / regional outlets).

Gaza

  • IDF/COGAT: winter supplies and humanitarian entries continue; medical and sanitation support being strengthened.
  • Media reports: Gaza’s power and healthcare at risk with incoming rain; cases of disputes over medical aid (example: six-year-old burn victim).

Maritime & U.S.-Israel ties

  • Commander of U.S. Fifth Fleet visited Israel; Israel and U.S. say maritime partnership strengthened.
  • Low-altitude Israeli drones reported over Beirut.

Iran — nuclear & military

  • IAEA: increasing concern; no information or access reported from Iran about facilities and materials.
  • U.S./Iran rhetoric rising — public statements escalate (reported Trump comments on Iran).

Yemen / Houthis

  • Ansarullah/Houthi advances reported (capture of Jabal al Misas and Al Fassayah); Yemeni government forces report repelling a large-scale Houthi attack on Al-Aqrud.

Economic

  • Brent crude reported rising toward ~$96 per barrel amid regional tensions.

Threat trend

  • Increased regional escalation across maritime, air, and Gaza fronts over the last 48 hours.

🟢 Good News

  • Humanitarian/winter aid entries to Gaza continue per IDF/COGAT.
  • U.S. Fifth Fleet visit signals stronger Israel–U.S. maritime coordination.
  • Yemeni government reports repelling a major Houthi attack.
